item.description:
Clauds 1.0.1

One fix for the account switch.

  • Claude opens again after a switch. A switch could wait 20 seconds, show "Claude did not quit", and leave Claude closed. You had to click the account a second time. The switch now continues as soon as Claude has quit.

Clauds 1.0.0

The first release of Clauds.

  • Switch accounts. One click changes the Claude desktop app to a different account. No account is signed out.
  • Side by Side. One Claude copy for each account, all open at the same time.
  • Shared Code sessions. Continue a Code session from a different account.
  • Live usage. The 5-hour, weekly, and weekly per-model limits of each account, with reset times.
  • Auto-switch near a limit. The app can go to the account with the most room. It asks first, or switches by itself. Off by default.
  • Self-update. The app shows what is new and lets you install it, skip it, or wait.
